params.name: collectionId
params.description: Key/id of the collection for which item should be filtered and returned.

params.name: q
params.description: A general text search filter.

params.name: bbox
params.description: A bbox filter, must be 4 comma-separated coordinates

params.name: filter
params.description: query parameter that represents a parse-able string of filter expressions, structured according to the Common Query Language Specification of the OGC Features API. If filter values must include whitespace, try wrapping the value in single quotes.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of results to return.

params.name: startindex
params.description: The initial index of the results to return, starting at 1.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of resource.

params.name: title
params.description: The title of resource to return.

params.name: recordId
params.description: The recordId of resource to return. recordId could be itemId or itemId_layerId

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Sort results by specific fields. Prefixed by either "+" for ascending or "-" for descending. If no prefix is provided, "+" is assumed.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags for items search

params.name: token
params.description: Token to use when accessing the underlying ArcGIS Item that represents the site.

params.name: openData
params.description: Boolean flag to get items that are shared to Opendata group

items.docs: Returns items from the specified site catalog collection that match specified filters
